schedule: Termly bursary eligibility and attendance review
escalationTrigger: Identity, constituency, duplicate support, enrolment or payment evidence is missing
escalationOwner: CDFC Chairperson and Council Education Officer
purpose: Control bursary applications, eligibility, prioritisation, award, disbursement and academic monitoring.
institution: Applicant, WDC, CDFC, Local Authority and Education Institution

steps.name: Verify bursary eligibility
steps.explanation: Check identity, constituency, vulnerability, admission and duplicate support.
steps.requiredEvidence: Identity, admission, vulnerability and constituency evidence

steps.name: Review and approve award
steps.explanation: WDC and CDFC score, prioritise and approve the configured award.
steps.requiredEvidence: Score, minutes, fee schedule and approval decision

steps.name: Disburse and monitor attendance
steps.explanation: Confirm authorised payment route, enrolment, attendance and renewal conditions.
steps.requiredEvidence: Payment receipt, enrolment and attendance evidence

rules.explanation: A bursary award must not duplicate another active support award without an approved exception.

escalations.action: Request missing eligibility or institution evidence
Escalate unsupported award or overdue monitoring

workflowName: CDF Information Dissemination and Public Disclosure
escalationTrigger: Disclosure approval, privacy review, correction or publication evidence is missing
escalationOwner: Council Public Information Officer and Data Protection Officer
purpose: Publish approved CDF information while protecting personal, sensitive and legally restricted data.
institution: Local Authority, WDC, CDFC, Province, Ministry and Public Information Office

steps.name: Prepare approved disclosure set
steps.explanation: Select certified financial, project, procurement and outcome information.
steps.requiredEvidence: Certified report and disclosure data set

steps.name: Complete privacy and sensitivity review
steps.explanation: Remove protected personal data and confirm lawful publication scope.

steps.name: Publish and preserve receipt
steps.explanation: Publish the approved information and preserve the public receipt and correction path.
steps.requiredEvidence: Publication URL, timestamp and correction contact

rules.explanation: CDF information must not be published before privacy and sensitivity review.

escalations.action: Request missing certification or publication evidence
Escalate unresolved privacy or sensitive-data concern
